---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspection Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(viridis)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data(rest_inspec)

restaurants = 
  rest_inspec |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(camis, dba, boro, street, cuisine_description, inspection_date, critical_flag, score, grade, grade_date) |>
  rename(
    ID_Number = camis,
    Restaurant_Name = dba,
    Borough = boro,
    Street_Address = street,
    Cuisine = cuisine_description,
    Inspection_Date = inspection_date, 
    Critical = critical_flag, 
    Score = score, 
    Grade = grade, 
    Grade_Date = grade_date
  ) |>
  drop_na(Score, Cuisine, Borough, Inspection_Date, Grade, Grade_Date, Critical) |>
  filter(Borough %in% c("Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Staten Island")) |>
   mutate(
    ID_Number = as.character(ID_Number),
    Restaurant_Name = as.character(Restaurant_Name),
    Street_Address = as.character(Street_Address),
    Borough = factor(Borough),
    Cuisine = factor(Cuisine),
    Critical  = factor(Critical, 
                       levels = c("Y", "N"),
                       labels = c("Critical", "Not Critical")),
    Grade = factor(Grade, 
                   levels = c("A", "B", "C"), 
                   ordered = TRUE),
    Score = as.numeric(Score),
    Inspection_Date = as.Date(Inspection_Date),
    Grade_Date = as.Date(Grade_Date)
  )

view(restaurants)

inspections =
  restaurants |>
  distinct(ID_Number, Inspection_Date, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Scatterplot 
```{r}
inspections |>
  filter(Borough == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(Cuisine %in% c("American", "French", "Indian", "Mexican", "Italian")) |>
  head(500) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~Inspection_Date, y = ~Score, color = ~Cuisine,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers"
  ) |>
  layout(title = "Inspection Scores Over Time in Manhattan by Cuisine")
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Boxplot 
```{r}
inspections |>
  plot_ly(x = ~Borough, y = ~Score, color = ~Borough, 
          type = "box") |>
  layout(title = "Inspection Scores by Borough")
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Bar chart 
```{r}
inspections |>
  count(Borough, Critical) |>
  filter(Critical == "Critical") |>
  plot_ly(x = ~Borough, y = ~n, color = ~Borough, 
    type = "bar"
  ) |>
  layout(title = "Number of Critical Inspections by Borough")
```
